post.description:
FR-38: cancel an ACCEPTED, PREPARING or READY order with a mandatory reason and a
100 % refund. The seat is always released; portions only from ACCEPTED (T6, T7, T9).

`version` is the order version the Administrator saw. A repeat with the same key
returns the same result; there is never a second refund.

403.description: Only the Administrator cancels any order

409.description: The order is PENDING_PAYMENT or terminal, the version is stale (current status, version and refund in the body), or the original request with this key is still in progress

422.description: No reason given, or the idempotency key was already used with a different request

503.description: Could not complete after retries; nothing was changed

get.description:
UC-25 step 1: proposals, newest first; PENDING only unless another status is asked for.

Proposals whose target start has passed, or that a newer one superseded, are
expired first (FR-56). Each names its run, whose report holds the forecast.

post.description:
FR-56, FR-57: re-validate, then apply the change, all in one transaction.

Item-disable flags the item until the end of the target date (FR-53), prep
priority orders the slot's kitchen totals (FR-54) and replenishment adds the
portions (FR-55), under the Administrator's identity with an audit entry that
links the proposal.

409.description: Not applied: already decided, EXPIRED (target start passed or superseded), or INVALIDATED by re-validation; `detail.proposal` has its status and reason

post.description: FR-56: REJECTED with the Administrator's reason; nothing is applied.

409.description: Already decided, or EXPIRED; `detail.proposal` has its status

put.description:
FR-17 / US-14: configure a service date's window and generate its slots.

Slots that orders reference are kept; FR-18 refuses a change that would remove one.

403.description: Only the Administrator configures service windows

409.description: A slot with orders would be removed, or its capacity would fall below its booked seats

422.description: Invalid window, capacity, or a slot length that does not divide it

patch.description: FR-18 / US-15: change one slot's capacity without dropping booked students.

403.description: Only the Administrator changes slot capacity

409.description: The capacity is below the seats already booked

422.description: Capacity outside 1-100, or an unknown field

post.description:
FR-43: Start (T5), Mark Ready (T8), Mark Picked Up (T10) or Mark No-show (T11).

Any other move is refused with 409 and changes nothing (FR-29). A no-show keeps
the portions and is not refunded. The order version is bumped, so a Student
acting on what they saw before gets 409.

403.description: Only Kitchen Staff and the Administrator move orders

409.description: Not a legal transition from the order's current state (status in the body), or a no-show before slot end + P-NOSHOW_GRACE (allowed_from in the body)

503.description: Could not complete after retries; nothing was changed

get.description:
FR-42: ACCEPTED, PREPARING and READY orders of the current and next slot.

Orders are sorted by slot start, then confirmation time. Each slot's item
totals follow its approved prep-priority proposal (FR-54) if there is one,
otherwise descending count. The kitchen screen polls this every P-POLL.

403.description: Only Kitchen Staff and the Administrator see the queue

get.description:
FR-28: the caller's own orders, newest first, each with its latest price.

Open one with GET /orders/{order_id} for every snapshot version and refund.

403.description: Only Students have orders

post.description:
FR-30, FR-33: reserve the portions and a seat, then take payment.

201 with the order in ACCEPTED, or in PAYMENT_FAILED (holds returned) when the
payment is declined or times out. A repeat with the same key returns the same order.

403.description: Only Students place orders

409.description: Ordering not open yet, an item or the slot is unavailable (named in the body), the price differs from the quote (fresh quote in the body), or the original request with this key is still in progress

422.description: Unknown item, quantity above P-MAX_QTY, already P-MAX_ACTIVE unfinished orders on that date, or the idempotency key was already used with a different cart

429.description: Too many order requests this minute (NFR-21)

503.description: Could not complete after retries; nothing was reserved

get.description:
FR-40, FR-28: the order's current status and every transition, price snapshot
version and refund so far, oldest first.

The client polls this every P-POLL while the order is not finished. Another
Student's order answers 404 and is logged as a security event (FR-7).

403.description: Only Students track orders

404.description: No such order, or it belongs to another Student

patch.description:
FR-35, FR-36: replace an ACCEPTED order's items and/or slot before slot start -
P-CUTOFF, atomically. The order is re-priced as snapshot v(n+1); a higher price is
charged for the difference, a lower one refunded exactly once (FR-39).

`lines` is the complete new cart. A repeat with the same key returns the same result.

402.description: The price difference was declined or timed out; the order is exactly as before

403.description: Only Students modify their own orders

404.description: No such order or slot, or the order is not the caller's

409.description: The order is not ACCEPTED, the cut-off has passed, the version is stale, an item or the slot is unavailable (named in the body), the price differs from the quote (fresh quote in the body), the order changed while the difference was being charged, or the original request with this key is still in progress

422.description: Unknown item, quantity above P-MAX_QTY, a slot on another day, nothing to change, or the idempotency key was already used with a different request

429.description: Too many order requests this minute (NFR-21)

503.description: Could not complete after retries; nothing was changed

post.description:
FR-37, FR-39: cancel from ACCEPTED (100 % refund, seat and portions restored) or
PREPARING (P-LATE_REFUND_PCT refund, seat restored) before slot start - P-CUTOFF.

`version` is the order version the Student confirmed. A repeat with the same key
returns the same result; there is never a second refund.

403.description: Only Students cancel their own orders

404.description: No such order, or not the caller's

409.description: The order is READY or terminal, the cut-off has passed, the version is stale (current status, version and refund in the body), or the original request with this key is still in progress

422.description: The idempotency key was already used with a different request

429.description: Too many order requests this minute (NFR-21)

503.description: Could not complete after retries; nothing was changed

404.description: No such order or slot, or the order is not the caller's

422.description: Unknown item, or quantity above P-MAX_QTY

post.description: FR-25: the full FR-24 breakdown for a cart and slot. Reserves nothing.

403.description: Only Students request quotes

422.description: Unknown or removed item, or quantity above P-MAX_QTY
